svg.aria-label: Nine original character concept screens, with three expression states for three characters NIM, LUNE and KIP, designed for a circular 240 by 240 pixel display
svg.text: Three distinct identities · each observed, delighted and suspicious · original flat-color 240×240 screen concepts
Design studies only — not firmware output. Actual viewing window: Ø31.4 mm, ~44% of current 72 mm-wide housing.
Choose a character before commissioning implementation, micro-animation and final case work. No licensed Reel assets reused.
